cards.question: What does a static lifetime mean?
cards.answer: The value will exist until the end of the program.

cards.question: Why can a static-lifetime value be shared across threads?
cards.answer: Because it exists until the end of the program.

cards.question: When does a static variable exist relative to main?
cards.answer: It exists before main and remains in scope until the program ends.

cards.question: How can a heap value be given a static lifetime?
cards.answer: By leaking it on the heap so it is guaranteed to exist for the program's entire duration.
